description: This file implements the PersistentStore class methods for managing key-value storage, including registration of endpoints, handling get/set/delete operations, and managing storage limits within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: PersistentStore
classes.description: A class providing key-value storage management with RPC endpoints, including registration, retrieval, deletion, and storage limit controls.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all RPC endpoints for the PersistentStore class.

methods.name: UnregisterAll
methods.description: Unregisters all RPC endpoints for the PersistentStore class.

methods.name: endpoint_setValue
methods.description: Handles setting a key-value pair in the store.

methods.name: endpoint_getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value and TTL for a given key.

methods.name: endpoint_deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specified key from the store.

methods.name: endpoint_getKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getStorageSize
methods.description: Deprecated. Retrieves storage sizes per namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getStorageSizes
methods.description: Retrieves storage sizes for all namespaces.

methods.name: endpoint_getNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets the storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_setNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets the storage limit for a namespace.
